entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I have a helmet I need to return. I think. I'm just so confused by the website. I ordered it a while ago and the box is still unopened, but I don't know if I can still send it back.
I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the helmet, or is this more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's the color. It looked different on my screen and it just doesn't match my bike at all. I know it's silly, but I haven't even taken it out. Can't you just help me? I find this all so overwhelming.
Of course, I'm happy to help. Let's get this sorted out for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF-886-2154.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered on October 3rd. Is that correct?
October? Oh my, has it been that long? See, this is what I was worried about. I'm probably too late.

Not at all. I've just checked our policy for you. For this particular helmet, we have a 90-day return window. Since you're at 69 days, you are well within the timeframe to make a return for a full refund.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much!

You're very welcome. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I'm going to process this with a complimentary, pre-paid return label to make it as easy as possible.
That is wonderful. I was so stressed about this.

I understand completely. We want you to be happy with your gear. When you're ready to look for a new helmet, feel free to give us a call back. We can help you find the perfect color match while ensuring you get the top-tier safety features you expect from VeloFit. I'll email that return label to you right now. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Alex. Thank you!
My pleasure. Have a great day and ride safe.
